title: Swallowed Star [Movie]: The Decisive Battle on the Primordial Star [PART-2]
description:
Swallowed Star [Movie]: The Decisive Battle on the Primordial Star, Swallowed Star The Movie: Battle on the Original Star, 吞噬星空之决战原始星, Lucifer Donghua, Chinese Anime Donghua, ( chinese anime | donghua 2026 ) 1st season All episodes English sub
During his training on the Original Star, Luo Feng faces constant threats from alien races coveting his strength and resources. Remaining calm and strategic, he uses both intelligence and power to counterattack and defend humanity’s honor. Wielding a formidable and beautiful battle blade, Luo Feng carves a path of destruction through his enemies, declaring, “I have a single strike that can sever the universe.”

As tensions escalate, the demon race, mechanical race, and insect race reappear and form a three-race alliance. Their leaders, along with 6,000 universe-level experts, join forces to encircle and eliminate Luo Feng. In the face of overwhelming odds, Luo Feng unleashes his ultimate technique, “I Am the Universe,” annihilating the coalition in one decisive strike.
